# netbox_mac_addresses (Data Source)

Lists mac_address objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_mac_addresses" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `mac_addresses` (Attributes List) The matching mac_addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mac_addresses))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--mac_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mac_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) Id of the interface the address is assigned to (see assigned_object_type).
- `assigned_object_type` (String) Content type of the interface the address is assigned to. Derived from device_interface_id or virtual_machine_interface_id when one of those is set. One of: dcim.interface, virtualization.vminterface.
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_interface_id` (Number) Id of the device interface the address is assigned to (assigned_object_type dcim.interface). Conflicts with virtual_machine_interface_id and with setting the assigned_object_* pair directly.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address (EUI-48) in colon, dash or dot notation, any case; the configured spelling is kept in state (NetBox stores it colon-separated and uppercased).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_machine_interface_id` (Number) Id of the virtual machine interface the address is assigned to (assigned_object_type virtualization.vminterface). Conflicts with device_interface_id and with setting the assigned_object_* pair directly.
